text: In May 2021, residents reached out to my office with an urgent concern about speeding along their street and requested via an online survey that traffic calming measures (speed humps) be installed as a method of addressing these concerns. Of the residents that responded, 89% were in support of making this change. I am requesting that speed humps be installed on Gordon Street from Sheridan Avenue to Dufferin Street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Waived the polling requirement under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and authorize the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Gordon Street, between Sheridan Avenue and Dufferin Street. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter sections of the roadway on Gordon Street, between Sheridan Avenue and Dufferin Street, to install two speed humps, generally as shown on the copy of 'Drawing No. 421G-4003' dated April 2022 from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
